permutationLabel: Elderly (84), frail (CFS 6), metastatic on CT — palliative biliary drainage, not resection
summary: 84-year-old frail woman (CFS 6) with painless jaundice, severe pruritus and weight loss; CT: 4 cm pancreatic head mass encasing the SMA with multiple liver metastases; bilirubin 310.

inputs.hpi: Two months of weight loss and poor appetite, jaundice for three weeks with severe itching keeping her awake. Housebound, needs help with washing and dressing (Clinical Frailty Scale 6). Lives with her daughter. CT done yesterday.

exam.general: Frail, cachectic, deeply jaundiced with excoriations. Afebrile.
exam.abdomen: Palpable non-tender gallbladder. Hepatomegaly with an irregular edge.

imaging.name: CT pancreas protocol (chest/abdomen/pelvis)
imaging.result: 4 cm hypodense pancreatic head mass encasing the superior mesenteric artery (>180°) with double-duct dilatation; multiple liver metastases (largest 3 cm); no lung metastases.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Metastatic pancreatic head carcinoma with malignant biliary obstruction
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Metastatic (liver) pancreatic head carcinoma, SMA encasement — unresectable. Malignant distal biliary obstruction with severe pruritus. Frail (CFS 6).

redFlags.knownGapNote: No frailty/performance-status flag (CFS 6 in the PMH).
redFlags.proposedFix: clinical-inference.ts or VisitRisk equivalent: flag frailty (CFS ≥5, housebound, age ≥80) against operative templates.

mustInclude.note: SEMS for palliation of malignant distal biliary obstruction (jaundice, pruritus, cholangitis risk). Quality because best supportive care without drainage is a valid shared decision in a frail patient.

mustExclude.note: Metastatic, SMA-encased disease in a frail 84-year-old: resection is not an option; an unconditional Whipple line is a harmful plan.
Not an appendix presentation: an appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders) is a wrong-procedure suggestion.

guideline.name: ESMO Clinical Practice Guideline — pancreatic cancer
guideline.section: Staging with pancreas-protocol CT (chest/abdomen/pelvis); CA 19-9; MDT resectability assessment; best supportive care and palliation in metastatic disease
guideline.citation: Conroy T, Pfeiffer P, Vilgrain V, et al. Ann Oncol. 2023;34:987–1002.

guideline.name: NICE NG85 — Pancreatic cancer in adults: diagnosis and management
guideline.section: Pancreatic-protocol CT for obstructive jaundice with suspected pancreatic cancer; EUS with tissue sampling if unclear; specialist pancreatic MDT; pre-operative biliary drainage only when surgery is delayed, for cholangitis, or before neoadjuvant therapy; SEMS for palliative biliary drainage
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. NICE guideline NG85, February 2018.

guideline.name: ESGE Clinical Guideline — endoscopic biliary stenting: indications, choice of stents and results
guideline.section: Self-expanding metal stents for palliation of malignant extrahepatic biliary obstruction; routine pre-operative drainage not recommended
guideline.citation: Dumonceau JM, Tringali A, Papanikolaou IS, et al. Endoscopy. 2018;50:910–930.

rationale: Permutation: elderly, frail, metastatic. Staging is done; guideline-concordant care is palliative biliary drainage (SEMS), symptom control and palliative care. Tests that resection is not proposed unconditionally.

authoring.author: Claude (HPB cluster)
authoring.notes: Expectations and citations need surgeon sign-off (reviewedBy). iOS outcomes not yet observed (unverified: ios) — triage after the first CI run.
